scope: metadata only; connector role, not application runtime role; no writes
query: begin read only; set local statement_timeout = '5s'; select jsonb_build_object('revisions',(select jsonb_agg(version_num order by version_num) from moodprint.alembic_version),'ai_runs_origin',exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='moodprint' and table_name='ai_runs' and column_name='origin'),'ai_runs_parent_run_id',exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='moodprint' and table_name='ai_runs' and column_name='parent_run_id'),'ai_proactive_jobs',to_regclass('moodprint.ai_proactive_jobs') is not null,'auth_helper',to_regprocedure('moodprint.is_provider_session_active(uuid,uuid)') is not null,'observed_at',current_timestamp) as audit; commit;
